claude-bridge/claude-fable-5.character: The advisor's own session model and the default planner. The advisor session runs at medium; planner nodes run at high. Shares the Anthropic session allowance — do not assign checking, review, reduction, browser verification, or implementation. When Anthropic capacity is reached, planning falls back to Grok at high and the advisor session switches to Grok.

claude-bridge/claude-sonnet-5.character: Luna replacement: cheap short-leash procedural work. Scouting, mechanical chores, routine mid-phase checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, and browser verification — deterministic anchors backstop it. Default reasoning is medium. Do not assign adversarial-tier checking, final whole-diff review, reduction, planning, or substantial implementation. Grok is the hefty-cycle model.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: The hefty cycle: implementation workhorse and adversarial-tier reviewer. Backend, data, mixed-stack, substantial existing-UX, greenfield UX (load frontend-design), research, schema/auth/security/money checks, final whole-diff review before PR, rechecks after an overturned pass, and reduction. Also the planning/advisor fallback when Fable is at Anthropic capacity. 200K window — keep packets bounded and split oversized reviews per package or phase. A Grok review of a Grok build is expected in this profile; the deterministic anchors are the independence backstop, not a second model. The only Cursor model this map may use. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default.

scout.description: Read-only investigation with bounded, source-linked findings.

planner.description: Plan fixed work from verified code and product constraints.

reducer.description: Reduce independent worker artifacts into bounded decisions and conflicts.

builder.description: Implement fixed acceptance criteria in one assigned worktree.

checker.description: Fresh-context review of the completed work, with a bounded inline-repair mandate for small findings. Adversarial tier and final whole-diff review run on Grok; procedural tier runs on Sonnet.

browser-verifier.description: Integrated browser verification and safe evidence capture. Defaults to Sonnet; use Grok only for a genuinely ambiguous visual or behavioral judgment.
